title: The Future of America’s Abortion Fight

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜总会打碟的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍爱的藏品去上班，你把DJ台变成了一个充满美丽50年历史文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自阿彼册的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔维内西。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: It was a devastating hearing for millions of women across this country who are watching the Supreme Court look like they are going to overturn Roe v.
sentences.zh: 对这个国家的数百万女性来说，这是一场毁灭性的听证会，她们看着最高法院似乎准备推翻罗诉

sentences.en: Wade and take us back into the days of back alley abortions.
sentences.zh: 韦德案，把我们带回到非法堕胎的年代。

sentences.en: This is a tremendous opportunity.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的机遇。

sentences.en: We are asking the court to overturn Roe v.
sentences.zh: 我们正在要求法院推翻罗诉

sentences.en: Wade and it's time.
sentences.zh: 韦德案，是时候了。

sentences.en: It's been nearly 50 years.
sentences.zh: 已经快50年了。

sentences.en: As the Supreme Court appears set to dramatically roll back abortion rights, later today, federal regulators are expected to issue a ruling that could significantly expand them.
sentences.zh: 正值最高法院似乎准备大幅削减堕胎权之际，预计联邦监管机构将在今天晚些时候发布一项可能大大扩大堕胎权的裁决。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Pam Bellick, about what that decision will mean for the future of the abortion fight in America.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事帕姆·贝利克，讨论这项决定将对美国未来堕胎斗争意味着什么。

sentences.en: So, Pam, we're at a moment in our country right now where we are fundamentally rethinking the laws around abortion.
sentences.zh: 帕姆，我们国家现在正处于一个重新根本思考堕胎相关法律的时刻。

sentences.en: And we're looking to next year to a potential reality where Roe, you know, the 1973 decision that made abortion legal nationally,
sentences.zh: 我们正在展望明年的潜在现实，即罗诉韦德案——你知道的，那个在全国范围内实现堕胎合法化的1973年裁决——

sentences.en: could very well be overturned and abortion would become illegal immediately in many states.
sentences.zh: 很可能会被推翻，许多州的堕胎将立即变得不合法。

sentences.en: And, of course, those who oppose abortion would see that as a real victory.
sentences.zh: 当然，那些反对堕胎的人会认为这是一场真正的胜利。

sentences.en: But people who support abortion rights are really worried.
sentences.zh: 但支持堕胎权的人却非常担忧。

sentences.en: You know, they say that it would mean going back to the time before Roe when abortions were really quite dangerous.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们说这意味着倒退回罗诉韦德案之前堕胎非常危险的时代。

sentences.en: And I guess my question for you is, is that right?
sentences.zh: 我想我的问题是，真的是这样吗？

sentences.en: How do women get abortions these days?
sentences.zh: 现在女性是如何堕胎的？

sentences.en: What does it look like out there?
sentences.zh: 外面的情况是怎样的？

sentences.en: Yeah, a lot of things have changed since the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 是的，自20世纪70年代以来，很多事情都发生了变化。

sentences.en: First of all, for the last 30 years, the abortion rate has been declining.
sentences.zh: 首先，在过去的30年里，堕胎率一直在下降。

sentences.en: Now we have about 900,000 abortions per year in this country, and the abortion rate is less than half of what it was in 1980.
sentences.zh: 现在我们这个国家每年大约有90万次堕胎，堕胎率不到1980年的一半。

sentences.en: The other major thing that's changed is the method.
sentences.zh: 另一个重大的变化是方法。

sentences.en: Before abortion was legal, it was often very unsafe for women who sought abortions.
sentences.zh: 在堕胎合法化之前，对于寻求堕胎的女性来说，这通常非常不安全。

sentences.en: And that's why we have the image of the coat hanger and back alley abortion.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们会有衣架和小巷堕胎的画面。

sentences.en: After Roe, when abortion became legal, the vast majority of abortions required women to have a surgical procedure that was performed in a hospital or clinic by a doctor.
sentences.zh: 在罗诉韦德案之后，当堕胎合法化时，绝大多数堕胎需要女性在医院或诊所由医生进行外科手术。

sentences.en: But in 2000, because of medical advancements, the FDA approved what is known as medication abortion.
sentences.zh: 但在2000年，由于医学进步，美国食品药品监督管理局批准了被称为药物流产的方法。

sentences.en: And they have grown in prevalence, and they now account for more than 40% of all abortions in the United States.
sentences.zh: 它们的普及率一直在上升，目前已占美国所有堕胎的40%以上。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: So what is medication abortion?
sentences.zh: 那么什么是药物流产呢？

sentences.en: So medication abortion involves two pills that women can take when they are up to 10 weeks pregnant.
sentences.zh: 药物流产包括两种药丸，女性在怀孕最长10周内可以服用。

sentences.en: And to give you a sense of when women get abortions in this country, about 80% of abortions occur within that time frame in this country.
sentences.zh: 为了让你了解这个国家女性何时堕胎，大约80%的堕胎发生在这个国家的那段时间内。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So an overwhelming majority of abortions are theoretically eligible for this medication abortion method.
sentences.zh: 因此，绝大多数堕胎在理论上都有资格采用这种药物流产方法。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But there has been one big hitch, which is that the first drug that you take is very, very strictly regulated by the FDA.
sentences.zh: 但有一个大问题，那就是你服用的第一种药物受到美国食品药品监督管理局非常、非常严格的监管。

sentences.en: That drug, it's called mifepristone.
sentences.zh: 这种药叫做米非司酮。

sentences.en: It blocks a hormone that's essential to pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 它阻断对怀孕至关重要的激素。

sentences.en: So it sort of stops the development of a pregnancy,
sentences.zh: 所以它有点像停止了怀孕的发育，

sentences.en: has been so strictly regulated that women have been compelled to go in person to a specially certified doctor to pick up that pill.
sentences.zh: 受到的监管非常严格，以至于女性不得不亲自去专门认证的医生那里领取这颗药丸。

sentences.en: And they can take the pill anywhere they want to, but they have to go to a doctor in a hospital or a clinic who is specially certified in order to get it.
sentences.zh: 她们可以在任何想去的地方服用这颗药丸，但她们必须去医院或诊所里专门认证的医生那里才能拿到它。

sentences.en: Now, for years,
sentences.zh: 现在，多年来，

sentences.en: medical experts and major organizations like the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists and the American Medical Association have said that there's years of data that show that medication abortion is very effective and very safe.
sentences.zh: 医学专家和主要组织（如美国妇产科医师学会和美国医学会）表示，多年的数据显示药物流产非常有效且非常安全。

sentences.en: And they have been pushing for quite a while to get mifepristone treated like any other drug.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在推动一段时间，让米非司酮像任何其他药物一样对待。

sentences.en: They say it is the only drug that the FDA regulates out of something like 20,000 drugs where you have to pick it up in person,
sentences.zh: 他们说这是美国食品药品监督管理局监管的大约20,000种药物中唯一一种你必须亲自去拿的药物，

sentences.en: but you don't actually have to take it in front of a physician.
sentences.zh: 但你实际上不必在医生面前服用它。

sentences.en: You can take the drug anywhere you want to.
sentences.zh: 你可以在任何你想吃的地方吃药。

sentences.en: So for years now, this has been something that these organizations have been pushing for, and yet women have still, in most cases,
sentences.zh: 所以多年来，这些组织一直在推动这一点，然而在大多数情况下，女性仍然

sentences.en: had to go into a doctor's office to pick up this medication.
sentences.zh: 不得不去医生的办公室领取这种药物。

sentences.en: But the pandemic changed that because during the coronavirus pandemic,
sentences.zh: 但大流行改变了这一点，因为在冠状病毒大流行期间，

sentences.en: everybody was concerned about limiting unnecessary medical visits because it put people at risk of getting infected with the virus.
sentences.zh: 每个人都关注限制不必要的医疗访问，因为这使人们面临感染病毒的风险。

sentences.en: These major medical organizations saw an opportunity to press the FDA to try to lift this restriction.
sentences.zh: 这些主要的医疗组织看到了向美国食品药品监督管理局施压以试图解除这种限制的机会。

sentences.en: They made the argument that it was putting women at unnecessary risk if they had to go to a doctor's office to get a drug when it wasn't necessary for safety reasons for them to get the drug at the doctor's office.
sentences.zh: 他们提出这样的论点：如果女性因为安全原因没有必要去医生的办公室却不得不去那里拿药，这会使她们面临不必要的风险。

sentences.en: And so after some back and forth in the courts, the Trump administration was fighting it.
sentences.zh: 所以在法院经历了一些来回之后，特朗普政府一直在与之抗争。

sentences.en: But when the Biden administration came in, the FDA decided to temporarily lift the in-person requirement for picking up the drug for the duration of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 但当拜登政府上台后，美国食品药品监督管理局决定在大流行期间暂时取消亲自领取药物的要求。

sentences.en: And now, today,
sentences.zh: 现在，今天，

sentences.en: we are expecting a decision from the FDA about whether it will permanently lift that in-person requirement and also whether it might lift any of the other restrictions that apply to mifepristone.
sentences.zh: 我们正等待美国食品药品监督管理局就其是否会永久取消亲自领取的要求以及是否可能取消适用于米非司酮的任何其他限制做出决定。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: What do you think it would mean if they did make that permanent?
sentences.zh: 如果他们真的让这一点成为永久性的，你认为这意味着什么？

sentences.en: I mean, how meaningful is the barrier of having to see a doctor in person for that first pill?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，为了第一颗药丸必须亲自去看医生的障碍有多大意义？

sentences.en: Well, for some women, it is very meaningful, especially people who don't have a lot of resources or a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对某些女性来说，这很有意义，尤其是那些没有太多资源或太多时间的人。

sentences.en: It can be an important barrier if you have to take time to go to a doctor's office.
sentences.zh: 如果你必须花时间去医生的办公室，这可能是一个重要的障碍。

sentences.en: And if you have to go to one that is specially certified, then that one might be a lot farther away.
sentences.zh: 如果你必须去一个经过专门认证的诊所，那么那个诊所可能会远得多。

sentences.en: So that can be a big barrier.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是一个巨大的障碍。

sentences.en: So instead of having to do that,
sentences.zh: 因此，不必这样做，

sentences.en: this allows women to have a virtual telemedicine appointment with a doctor who can then prescribe her the pills and mail them to her at her home or any location where she wants to receive them.
sentences.zh: 这允许女性与医生进行虚拟远程医疗预约，然后医生可以给她开药并将它们邮寄到她家或她想接收它们的任何地点。

sentences.en: And the other aspect of this is that because you can take abortion pills in the privacy of your own home or in your office or your car or wherever you want to,
sentences.zh: 另一个方面是，因为你可以在自己家的私密空间、办公室、汽车里或任何你想去的地方服用堕胎药，

sentences.en: not having to go to a clinic allows you to avoid maybe encountering abortion protesters or just sort of allows you to be more private in undertaking this procedure.
sentences.zh: 不必去诊所可以让你避免遇到堕胎抗议者，或者只是让你在进行这项手术时更加私密。

sentences.en: And so for a lot of women, medication abortion is an appealing method to use because it allows them to be private.
sentences.zh: 因此，对许多女性来说，药物流产是一种有吸引力的方法，因为它允许她们保持私密。

sentences.en: So Pam, it sounds like if the FDA does decide to permanently change the rules and say women don't need to go into a doctor's office to get this first pill,
sentences.zh: 所以帕姆，听起来如果美国食品药品监督管理局决定永久改变规则并表示女性不需要去医生的办公室拿这第一颗药丸，

sentences.en: that the barrier to getting an abortion in America would get lower, which would mean that the medication abortion would become even more common as a method.
sentences.zh: 在美国堕胎的障碍将降低，这意味着药物流产将作为一种方法变得更加普遍。

sentences.en: So I guess when I think back to the 1970s, I mean, that's just a really different picture, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我想当我回想起20世纪70年代时，我的意思是，那完全是另一幅画面，对吧？

sentences.en: It's not the image of abortion that comes to mind when you think of the fight today and how people on both sides are presenting it.
sentences.zh: 当你想到今天的斗争以及双方如何呈现它时，这不是浮现在脑海中的堕胎形象。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think the public debate has not really reflected these changes that have been happening over the last few years with medication abortion.
sentences.zh: 我认为公众辩论并没有真正反映过去几年药物流产一直在发生的变化。

sentences.en: And if this barrier is lifted permanently, that will be a really significant step.
sentences.zh: 如果这个障碍被永久解除，那将是非常重要的一步。

sentences.en: But as with everything involving the abortion issue, it's a lot more complicated than that.
sentences.zh: 但与涉及堕胎问题的一切一样，事情要复杂得多。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《交易手册》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市交易手册峰会的舞台上现场采访商业、政治和文化领域一些最重要的领袖，包括JD

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经筛选的对话实时发生。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在nytimes.com上现场直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download The New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订户，您可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看并获得一个月免费访问我们所有新闻报道的权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收听。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: So, Pam, what would this actually mean in practice?
sentences.zh: 所以，帕姆，这在实践中到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: I mean, if this rule was relaxed permanently, if you're in Texas or in Mississippi or in one of the other 19 states where abortion is being restricted,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果这个规则被永久放松，如果你在得克萨斯州、密西西比州或堕胎受到限制的其他19个州之一，

sentences.en: could you just telemedicine a doctor in California and that doctor mail you pills?
sentences.zh: 你可以直接远程医疗联系加利福尼亚州的医生，然后那个医生给你寄药丸吗？

sentences.en: No, it's not really that simple, although I think it's possible that a doctor in California or a state like California will try that.
sentences.zh: 不，其实没那么简单，尽管我认为加利福尼亚州或像加利福尼亚州这样的州的医生可能会尝试这样做。

sentences.en: But what you have is a real patchwork of laws that varies state to state.
sentences.zh: 但你拥有的是一个因州而异的真正法律拼凑。

sentences.en: There are different laws on abortion.
sentences.zh: 关于堕胎有不同的法律。

sentences.en: There are different laws on telemedicine.
sentences.zh: 关于远程医疗有不同的法律。

sentences.en: So right now there are 19 states where it is not possible to have a telemedicine appointment with a physician and get abortion pills then sent to you by mail.
sentences.zh: 所以现在有19个州不可能与医生进行远程医疗预约然后让堕胎药通过邮寄方式寄给你。

sentences.en: So even if the FDA lifted that restriction, there are 19 states, most of them in the South and the Midwest,
sentences.zh: 因此，即使美国食品药品监督管理局取消了该限制，仍有19个州，其中大多数在南部和中西部，

sentences.en: that would prevent that from happening through one or two different kinds of laws.
sentences.zh: 将通过一两种不同类型的法律阻止这种情况发生。

sentences.en: Then you have about 20 states where it is legal to have a telemedicine appointment with a doctor in your state or a doctor who is licensed in your state,
sentences.zh: 然后你大约有20个州，在那里与你所在州的医生或在你所在州获得许可的医生进行远程医疗预约是合法的，

sentences.en: even if they're not physically located there.
sentences.zh: 即使他们没有实际身处那里。

sentences.en: And that doctor can then write a prescription and you can get those pills sent to you by mail.
sentences.zh: 然后这位医生可以开处方，你可以通过邮寄方式把这些药丸寄给你。

sentences.en: So in 19 states, this ruling wouldn't really change very much, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来在19个州，这项裁决不会改变太多。

sentences.en: It would be illegal to get these pills in the mail from doctors in your state or from doctors in a different state.
sentences.zh: 从你所在州的医生或其他州的医生那里通过邮寄获得这些药丸将是非法的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But if you're living in a state where you are not allowed sitting at home to have a telemedicine appointment with a doctor
sentences.zh: 但如果你住在这样一个州：坐在家里不允许你与医生进行远程医疗预约

sentences.en: and have that doctor send you abortion pills, you could travel to another state where that is allowed.
sentences.zh: 并让该医生给你寄堕胎药，你可以去另一个允许这样做的州。

sentences.en: And that would likely be less expensive and a bit easier for you than traveling to a state where a surgical abortion is allowed
sentences.zh: 对你来说，这可能比去一个允许手术流产的州、

sentences.en: and getting an appointment at a clinic and having to have surgery, which is what women in states where abortion is restricted do now.
sentences.zh: 在诊所预约并必须进行手术要便宜一些，也容易一点，这是堕胎受限制的州的女性现在正在做的事情。

sentences.en: So if you have to travel to a state in order to get an abortion, it's going to be easier for you to do that
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你为了堕胎必须去另一个州，在这样一个系统下做这件事会更容易，

sentences.en: under a system where you can just, you know, sit in a hotel room in that state or, you know, your cousin's house
sentences.zh: 在这个系统下你可以，你知道，坐在那个州的酒店房间里，或者，你知道，你表弟的家里，

sentences.en: or even just kind of sit in your car and have your telemedicine appointment and have the pills mailed to a post office box address.
sentences.zh: 甚至只是坐在你的车里进行远程医疗预约，并将药丸邮寄到邮政信箱地址。

sentences.en: And it will be less expensive than getting a surgical abortion.
sentences.zh: 而且它将比做手术流产便宜。

sentences.en: So for some women in those states where it's banned, I think it's easier than having to go to another state to get a surgical abortion.
sentences.zh: 所以对于那些被禁止堕胎的州的某些女性来说，我认为这比去另一个州做手术流产更容易。

sentences.en: And also, it's harder to enforce a law against receiving something in the mail, you know, unless somebody's going to open every package,
sentences.zh: 而且，执行一项关于通过邮政接收某物的法律更难，你知道，除非有人要打开每个包裹，

sentences.en: which doesn't happen, it's easier to get around that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 这不会发生，绕过那种事情更容易。

sentences.en: So you can see a situation where somebody could go to a state where it's legal, you know, sit in their car,
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看到这样一种情况：某人可以去一个合法的州，你知道，坐在他们的车里，

sentences.en: even do the telemedicine appointment, give the doctor there an address in that state.
sentences.zh: 甚至进行远程医疗预约，给那里的医生一个那个州的地址。

sentences.en: Maybe it's a friend or a relative, and then maybe that relative could send it to you.
sentences.zh: 也许是一个朋友或亲戚，然后那个亲戚可以把它寄给你。

sentences.en: I mean, for some women, it will make access easier, even if they're living in a state that prohibits it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对某些女性来说，这将使获取变得更容易，即使她们住在禁止它的州。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this ruling could make it easier for people to get these pills legally, but also illegally,
sentences.zh: 所以这项裁决可能会让人们更容易合法地获得这些药丸，但也会非法地获得，

sentences.en: because this whole realm of telemedicine and getting pills through the mail is just much, much harder to police.
sentences.zh: 因为远程医疗和通过邮寄获取药丸的整个领域只是更难、更难监管。

sentences.en: Yes, I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是这样的。

sentences.en: However, if the FDA does permanently lift this restriction, I think we will see a whole series of reactions on both sides of the abortion debate
sentences.zh: 然而，如果美国食品药品监督管理局确实永久取消了这一限制，我认为我们将会看到堕胎辩论双方的一系列反应，

sentences.en: that could change the landscape in unpredictable ways.
sentences.zh: 这些反应可能会以意想不到的方式改变格局。

sentences.en: How do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, I think that states that are conservative and are inclined to restrict abortion will unleash as many different ways as they can think of
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为保守且倾向于限制堕胎的州将释放出他们能想到的尽可能多的不同方法，

sentences.en: to try to further restrict access to medication abortion.
sentences.zh: 试图进一步限制获取药物流产的途径。

sentences.en: You're already seeing that during the pandemic and during this past year.
sentences.zh: 在大流行期间和过去的一年里，你已经看到了这一点。

sentences.en: So far, six states have adopted bans on the mailing of abortion pills.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，有六个州通过了对邮寄堕胎药的禁令。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: And four states have adopted laws that try to restrict how late you can get a medication abortion.
sentences.zh: 四个州通过了法律，试图限制你可以进行药物流产的时间。

sentences.en: In some cases, like in Texas, trying to roll it back to seven weeks.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，比如在得克萨斯州，试图将其回滚到七周。

sentences.en: On the other side, in states that favor abortion rights, you're going to see a kind of flowering of efforts to try to take advantage of this.
sentences.zh: 在另一边，在支持堕胎权的州，你会看到各种各样的努力，试图利用这一点。

sentences.en: Again, you're already seeing that in the last year or so since the restriction on Mifepristone was temporarily lifted.
sentences.zh: 同样，自从米非司酮的限制被临时解除以来，在过去的一年左右里，你已经看到了这一点。

sentences.en: You have organizations like Hey Jane and Abortion on Demand, and these are, you know, online sites where if you live in a certain number of states,
sentences.zh: 你有像Hey Jane和Abortion on Demand这样的组织，这些是，你知道的，在线网站，如果你住在一定数量的州，

sentences.en: you can get online, get access to telemedicine consultation, and get abortion pills mailed to you legally.
sentences.zh: 你可以上网，获得远程医疗咨询，并合法地将堕胎药邮寄给你。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So it's kind of a cottage industry springing up on the internet, where the main reason these organizations exist is to make it easier to get these abortion pills.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像在互联网上兴起的一个家庭手工业，这些组织存在的主要原因是为了更容易获得这些堕胎药。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And another thing that we're going to see in states where medication abortion by mail is illegal is something, again, that we're already seeing.
sentences.zh: 我们将在通过邮寄进行药物流产非法的州看到的另一件事是，同样，我们已经看到的事情。

sentences.en: There's an organization called Aid Access, which is based in Europe, and it will allow women to go online, fill out a form.
sentences.zh: 有一个名为Aid Access的组织，总部设在欧洲，它将允许女性上网，填写表格。

sentences.en: They can get a doctor to prescribe pills that if they live in a state where it's illegal, those pills will be mailed from a pharmacy in India.
sentences.zh: 如果她们住在非法的州，她们可以找医生开药，这些药将从印度的药房邮寄过来。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: And the FDA has tried to restrict aid access for the last couple of years, but it's very hard to do that.
sentences.zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局在过去几年里试图限制援助获取，但这很难做到。

sentences.en: I think they've intercepted maybe a few packages of pills, but it's very hard for them to know where they're sending these pills to.
sentences.zh: 我想他们可能拦截了几包药丸，但他们很难知道他们把这些药丸寄到哪里。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then recently, the head of Aid Access, a doctor named Rebecca Gompertz,
sentences.zh: 然后最近，Aid Access 的负责人、一位名叫丽贝卡·戈姆珀茨的医生，

sentences.en: has actually started doing something else in the United States where she's been sending pills to women who are not yet pregnant
sentences.zh: 实际上在美国开始做另一件事，她一直在向尚未怀孕的女性寄送药丸

sentences.en: just to sort of have, you know, kind of on hand in the event they have an unplanned pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 以防万一她们发生意外怀孕，可以提前备好。

sentences.en: And so this is a little bit of a more kind of edgy step, but it is starting to gain some acceptance among abortion rights advocates in the United States
sentences.zh: 所以这算是一个稍微有点前卫的举动，但它开始在美国的堕胎权倡导者中获得一些认可

sentences.en: who say, hey, you know, we do this with some other drugs.
sentences.zh: 他们说，嘿，你知道的，我们在其他一些药物上也是这么做的。

sentences.en: You can keep it in your medicine cabinet.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它放在家里的药箱里。

sentences.en: Why not do it with abortion pills?
sentences.zh: 为什么对堕胎药就不能这样呢？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Like getting Cipro before you go on a trip to some developing country.
sentences.zh: 就像去发展中国家旅行前先准备好环丙沙星一样。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: But I think that it's pretty unlikely that the FDA would authorize this kind of thing anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 但我认为美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）在短期内批准这种做法的可能性微乎其微。

sentences.en: You know, for one thing, there's certainly going to be questions about how do you make sure women are using the pills correctly,
sentences.zh: 你知道，一方面，人们肯定会质疑如何确保女性正确使用这些药丸，

sentences.en: taking them within 10 weeks and not 12 weeks, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 比如在10周内服用而不是12周，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: But this is an example of the kind of thing that we're going to see debated.
sentences.zh: 但这只是我们将看到被讨论的这类事情的一个例子。

sentences.en: And I think both sides will continue to push the envelope and come up with creative ways to take advantage of whatever the new legal reality is.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为双方将继续突破极限，想出创造性的方法来利用任何新的法律现实。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: You know, Pam, I've reported a lot on the abortion battles, as you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道，帕姆，正如你所知，我报道过很多关于堕胎之争的新闻。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm thinking about this, and it really strikes me that for a long, long time, the fight was this real kind of visceral, in-your-face thing where you had, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我在思考这个问题，我真的深有感触，很长很长一段时间以来，这场斗争是一种非常本能的、针锋相对的事情，比如，

sentences.en: the shout the abortion on one side and the fetuses on poster board on the other.
sentences.zh: 一边是高喊堕胎权，另一边则是举着胎儿照片的海报。

sentences.en: And it really revolved around kind of clinics and brick-and-mortar physical things.
sentences.zh: 它 realmente 围绕着诊所和实体建筑展开。

sentences.en: But this is something different.
sentences.zh: 但这次有些不同。

sentences.en: This is far away from that.
sentences.zh: 这与过去相去甚远。

sentences.en: It's really harder to visualize, right?
sentences.zh: 确实更难形象化了，对吧？

sentences.en: It's harder to kind of have that fight be focused around a place or doctors, a clinic.
sentences.zh: 很难让这种斗争聚焦于某个地方、医生或诊所。

sentences.en: I'm wondering how you think this different focus will change the fight itself.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你认为这种不同的焦点将如何改变这场斗争本身。

sentences.en: I mean, what will it look like?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它会是什么样子的？

sentences.en: And what will happen next year when the Supreme Court rules on that very important case in Mississippi
sentences.zh: 明年最高法院对密西西比州那起非常重要的案件做出裁决时会发生什么？

sentences.en: that will decide the fate of Roe, which extended federal protection for abortion to begin with?
sentences.zh: 该案将决定罗伊案的命运，而罗伊案最初将联邦对堕胎的保护推广到了全国？

sentences.en: Yeah, I do think that medication abortion will be the battleground where both the anti-abortion and abortion rights folks meet, much more so than they have in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，我确实认为药物流产将成为反堕胎人士和堕胎权支持者交锋的主战场，这比以往任何时候都要多。

sentences.en: I think this will be the new frontier.
sentences.zh: 我认为这将是新的前沿。

sentences.en: More and more women will be getting abortions by pill, and that will change everything from laws to how the sides in the abortion debate can fight with each other, right?
sentences.zh: 越来越多的女性将通过药丸进行流产，这将改变一切，从法律到堕胎辩论中双方如何相互抗争，对吧？

sentences.en: It's going to be a lot harder in some ways to kind of rally the troops on both sides because it's a much quieter type of procedure and the location is much more private.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，要动员双方的人马会困难得多，因为这是一个安静得多的程序，而且地点要私密得多。

sentences.en: So I think, you know, the sort of very in-your-face visceral stuff may not happen as often.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，那种非常针锋相对、诉诸本能的东西可能不会那么频繁地发生了。

sentences.en: But I have no doubt that the temperature in the abortion debate is not going to be turned down.
sentences.zh: 但我毫不怀疑，堕胎辩论的热度不会因此降温。

sentences.en: And just to give you, you know, one recent example, just this month when the Supreme Court was hearing the Mississippi abortion case right outside the Supreme Court,
sentences.zh: 仅举一个最近的例子，就在这个月，当最高法院在最高法院外审理密西西比州堕胎案时，

sentences.en: there were several women from Shout Your Abortion who weren't pregnant, but who were taking mifepristone pills right in front of the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 有几位来自“大声喊出你的堕胎”（Shout Your Abortion）组织的女性，她们并没有怀孕，但却直接在最高法院门前服用了米非司酮药丸。

sentences.en: And I think we're going to see more of that kind of political theater on both sides probably.
sentences.zh: 我想我们可能会看到双方更多这种类型的政治作秀。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I guess, Pam, if we've learned anything over the past 40 years, it's that America always finds a way to fight about abortion, that both sides will come up with new arguments.
sentences.zh: 我想，帕姆，如果我们过去40年里学到了什么，那就是美国总能找到争论堕胎的方法，双方都会想出新的论点。

sentences.en: You know, the symbolism might be different, but the fight will go on.
sentences.zh: 你知道，象征意义可能会有所不同，但斗争将继续下去。

sentences.en: And for many women, so will abortions, regardless of the laws and court decisions.
sentences.zh: 对于许多女性来说，堕胎也将继续，无论法律和法院判决如何。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, on the one hand, this is a very different landscape than before Roe v.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一方面，这与罗伊诉韦德案之前的景象截然不同，

sentences.en: Wade, right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: We're not talking about dangerous, you know, back alley abortions.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的不是危险的、你知道的地下诊所堕胎。

sentences.en: We're talking about putting postage stamps on a package of abortion pills that a woman can receive at home and take in her own kitchen on her own time.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是在装有堕胎药的包裹上贴上邮票，女性可以在家里收到，并在自己方便的时候在自己的厨房里服用。

sentences.en: And it's a method that is much safer than ways that women tried to accomplish abortions before it was legal.
sentences.zh: 而且这种方法比合法化之前女性尝试流产的方式安全得多。

sentences.en: So there is a lot that has changed.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多事情已经改变了。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, things may be the same in that women will still have to scramble to get an abortion, especially if Roe is rolled back.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，事情可能又是一样的，女性仍然不得不艰难地寻求堕胎，特别是如果罗伊案被推翻的话。

sentences.en: And the women who will face the biggest obstacles will still be low income women, which has always been the case.
sentences.zh: 而将面临最大障碍的仍然是低收入女性，情况一直如此。

sentences.en: So in a way, everything has changed and nothing has changed.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，一切都变了，又似乎什么都没变。

sentences.en: Pam, thank you.
sentences.zh: 帕姆，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，甚至不需要输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the Federal Reserve announced a major policy shift, saying it would withdraw pandemic-era aid faster than expected, because the economy had largely recovered.
sentences.zh: 周三，美联储宣布了一项重大的政策转变，称由于经济已基本复苏，它将以比预期更快的速度撤回疫情时期的援助。

sentences.en: The Fed said the change would help it tackle inflation by putting it in a position to raise interest rates, its most powerful tool for influencing the economy.
sentences.zh: 美联储表示，此举将使其处于加息的位置，从而帮助其应对通货膨胀，而加息是其影响经济的最强有力工具。

sentences.en: Rates, currently near zero, are expected to rise three times next year.
sentences.zh: 目前接近零的利率预计明年将上调三次。

sentences.en: And COVID deaths in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国的COVID-19死亡人数

sentences.en: surpassed 800,000, the highest known number of any country in the world.
sentences.zh: 超过了80万，是世界上已知任何国家中最高的数字。

sentences.en: Older Americans made up three-quarters of those deaths.
sentences.zh: 老年美国人占了这些死亡人数的三分之二以上。

sentences.en: One out of every hundred Americans over the age of 65 have died from COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 每100名65岁以上的美国人中就有一人死于COVID-19。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Luke Vanderploeg and Rochelle Bonja, with help from Daniel Guimet and Claire Tennis-Sketter.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由卢克·范德普洛格（Luke Vanderploeg）和罗谢尔·邦贾（Rochelle Bonja）制作，丹尼尔·吉梅（Daniel Guimet）和克莱尔·坦尼斯-斯凯特（Claire Tennis-Sketter）提供协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Paige Cowett and engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 它由佩奇·考维特（Paige Cowett）剪辑，克里斯·伍德（Chris Wood）进行工程制作。

sentences.en: It contains original music by Dan Powell and Marian Lozano.
sentences.zh: 它包含丹·鲍威尔（Dan Powell）和马里安·洛萨诺（Marian Lozano）的原创音乐。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brumberg and Ben Landsverk of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由来自 Wonderly 的吉姆·布隆伯格（Jim Brumberg）和本·兰斯维克（Ben Landsverk）创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日简报》的内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尼西（Sabrina Tavernisi）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让你的客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是为了睡觉而昏迷过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症、食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上寻找《Wirecutter秀》。
